text:
Ava Rivera: hey team, heads up — I'm at the airport, flight delayed 4+ hrs. i've got pager open but need to swap primary for my 18:00-02:00 UTC shift. there's an active latency incident on embeddings (INC-5423) with some ongoing retries hitting our dedicated pool. i can hand off context and runbook links now.

Samir Patel: @Ava Rivera thanks for the ping. i can take primary for the window. quick Q: are there any customer-impacting 5xx spikes?

incident-bot: [INCIDENT] INC-5423 — Elevated 5xx rate for embeddings service since 2026-03-15T16:42:02Z. Pager triggered at 16:43. Current severity: P2. Affected customers: a subset of high-throughput pipelines (eu-west).

Ava Rivera: yes, we've seen a ~6% 5xx uplift on the eu-west pool. retries are causing queue pressure on dedicated GPUs. manual mitigation applied: rolled back a new kernel patch on pool-gpu-12 which dropped errors to ~3%, but still above baseline. logs + traces: https://redwood.internal/incs/INC-5423

Lena Chen: copy. thanks @Ava. runbook excerpt i used: 
```
1) check pool utilization: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=dedicated-eu-west`
2) examine worker logs: `rdw logs worker-*-ded-euw --since 10m`
3) fallback to quantized model variant: set route weight 80/20 primary->quantized
4) restart unhealthy workers gradually (canary 1/5)
```
if you want me to do the quantized fallback after handoff, i can.

Ava Rivera: that excerpt is perfect. i've linked the specific runbook section in the thread. i also left the suggested canary commands in the incident ticket. i'm handing off state: `pool-gpu-12` patched rollback done, `route: embeddings-eu-west` pinned to v2.1.3 for now, canary cooldown 5m.

Samir Patel: i'll take primary. copying a short checklist soon: 
- accept pager and set yourself as primary in pagerduty
- monitor pool metrics (latency, errors, queue depth) for 15m windows
- if errors >4% after 10m, apply quantized fallback (route 80/20)
- if customer impact increases, escalate to oncall L2 and alert SRE lead

Theo Morgan: @Samir noted. i'll be secondary and shadow; i'll watch traces and be ready to roll back any quick changes. also ping SRE lead (Liam) if we need capacity shift between regions.

Samir Patel: accepted pager. set myself primary in pd and added `Ava Rivera` as outgoing owner. started a quick dashboard watch: https://dashboards.redwood/embeds/eu-west-live

incident-bot: [ACTION] Pager ownership changed: primary -> Samir Patel at 2026-03-15T16:56:10Z

Ava Rivera: thanks all — i've posted the brief root cause notes in INC-5423 (kernel patch interaction with KV cache for long sequences). i'm going to head to the gate but will keep phone for critical escalations.

Samir Patel: will run the fallback if we cross thresholds. quick note for handoff: logs show a recurring stacktrace from worker-7: `kernel_launch failed: CUDA_OUT_OF_MEMORY` under burst traffic. likely regression with the new patch. plan: try quantized variant to reduce mem, then restart workers one by one.

Lena Chen: tagging runbook step for memory regressions and adding `restart-order` snippet: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/worker-ded-euw --selector=worker=worker-7` (do one at a time).

Samir Patel: ack. i'll keep updates in this thread every ~10 minutes or on change. if anyone sees customer-facing increase, call it out. thanks @Ava for the warm handoff. :thumbsup:

Ava Rivera: appreciate it. safe patching and ping me if you want me to cut a quick rollback PR remotely.

Theo Morgan: standing by. i'll take over urgent page if Samir needs a break.

Samir Patel: update: 5m after swap, error rate trending down at 3.2%. if it holds we'll avoid the fallback. posting metrics now.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] INC-5423: error rate 3.2% -> 2.9% (16:05 UTC). next check in 10m.

Lena Chen: great—leaving runbook pointers in ticket and marking this handoff as complete in our internal ops doc.

Samir Patel: handoff confirmed. primary: Samir Patel, secondary: Theo Morgan, outgoing: Ava Rivera. ongoing incident INC-5423, monitoring and mitigation in progress. last update here at 2026-03-15T17:01:55Z.
